tools.name: find_performer_times
tools.description: When and where a named Ottawa Buskerfest act performs across the whole festival.

name.description: Act name, or part of it.

tools.name: get_festival_schedule
tools.description: Ottawa Buskerfest's performance schedule for one festival day: every act, stage and start time. Start times only — sets have no published end time.

day.description: Festival day, one of: 2026-08-07, 2026-08-08, 2026-08-09. Defaults to today if the festival is on.

tools.name: whats_on_now
tools.description: What is performing right now at Ottawa Buskerfest, by stage, plus what starts next. Only meaningful during the festival (August 7–9 2026).
